title: Local annihilation of cyclic cohomology classes kills their higher direct image
statement:
Let $h:Y\to X$ be any morphism of schemes, and $e,q\in\mathbf N$. Suppose that for every affine etale $U\to X$ and every class in $H^q(Y\times_X U,\mathbf Z/e)$ there is a jointly surjective etale family $V_i\to U$ on which its cohomology pullback is zero. Then $R^q h_*\underline{\mathbf Z/e}$, computed as the homology of the bounded-below derived pushforward in abelian sheaves, is a zero object. Here $\mathbf Z/0$ means $\mathbf Z$.

proof.text: Use the free-representable derived-Hom presheaf P from the abelian higher-direct-image sheafification comparison. For every affine etale object A, use the cyclic comparison to send a raw class to H^q(Y times_X A,Z/e); its zero-restriction implication turns the covering supplied by H into zero restrictions of the raw class.

For an arbitrary etale W and raw class xi, cover W by W.left.affineCover. Over each point choose a chart a:A to W and apply the previous step to P.map a.op xi. Compose a with an arrow b:B to A from its annihilating cover. Functoriality gives P.map (b comp a).op xi=0 and the composite hits the chosen point. Hence the equalizer sieve of xi and zero is jointly surjective, and therefore covering in the small etale topology.

The covering equalizer sieve is contained in the image sieve of the zero endomorphism of P, so that endomorphism is locally surjective. Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_presheafToSheaf_map_iff transfers local surjectivity to the sheafified zero endomorphism. Sheafification is additive, so that endomorphism is zero. Mathlib Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi′ makes it epi; IsZero.of_epi_zero implies the associated sheaf is zero. Transport across nonempty_higherDirectImage_iso_sheafification_abelian_single. The value universe is u+1, which contains both site universes.
